title: Saigon hipster areas
sub: 5 cool neighbourhoods to wander in Ho Chi Minh City, Nov 2026
tip: Grab bikes are the easiest way between them. The old apartment-block cafés are up narrow stairs or a lift that charges ~3–5k VND. Go late afternoon into evening: it's cooler and the bars open.

places.name: Nguyễn Thái Bình & 14 Tôn Thất Đạm
notes: Time Out's 11th coolest neighbourhood in the world (2025)
14 Tôn Thất Đạm is a run-down block full of indie fashion, vintage and cafés
Dense grid of workshops, vintage markets, bars and creative spaces

places.name: Tân Định
notes: Start at the pink church, then get lost in the low-rise lanes behind it
Cà Phê Đỗ Phủ (113A Đặng Dung) hides a wartime commando bunker

places.name: The Café Apartment
notes: Old 1960s block, every flat now a café, shop or bar
Touristy but fun: best view of the walking street from the upper balconies

places.name: District 3 / Hồ Con Rùa
notes: Leafy French-villa streets, less touristy than D1
Turtle Lake roundabout fills with students snacking at night
Villa cafés and good street food on the side streets

places.name: Thảo Điền
notes: Expat-y riverside village: craft beer, brunch, design shops
The Factory Contemporary Arts Centre (15 Nguyễn Ư Dĩ) is the art highlight, Tue–Sun 10am–7pm
Pin is the middle of the ward; it's ~20 min from D1
